newsitem.title: USA: DTM Corp expects Q2, full year 1997 loss.
newsitem.headline: DTM Corp expects Q2, full year 1997 loss.

text.p: DTM Corp said Wednesday it expects to report second quarter and full year 1997 results significantly below previous estimates.

It said it expects to report a loss for both the quarter and the year, and said net loss for the year should be $1.5 million to $2 million, excluding a previously disclosed one-time charge of $2.9 million for compensation expense related to its Equity Appreciation Plan.
First Call estimates for the company were unavailable.
However, the company said it expects increased unit sales and revenues for the second quarter and full year when compared to those for the 1996 periods.
It attributed its lowered expectations to ongoing softness in the North American markets, increased price competition world-wide, including currency effects and changes in anticipated product mix.
"In light of these developments, management has implemented a realignment of its engineering and development resources," the company said in a statement Wednesday evening. It said

it will accelerate programs to cut product costs and to improve its Selective Laser Sintering materials systems, and that it would postpone or cancell other programs, including the development of some planned upgrade options.

"We believe that these steps are necessary to position the company for future growth and to respond to current competitive and market situations. We expect strong growth in the Rapid Prototyping market and believe that our Selective Laser Sintering technology is uniquely positioned to participate in that growth," the company statement said.
